f2.en: Two ways we support new families
f2.zh: 两大核心服务，全程用心陪伴

f3.en: Whether you need hands-on postpartum support or want to become a confinement carer yourself, we're here to help.
f3.zh: 无论您是需要专业的产后护理支持，还是想成为一名月嫂，我们都能为您提供帮助。

f5.en: We match vetted, experienced NZ confinement nannies with families in Australia for live-in or live-out postpartum support, newborn care and traditional recovery practices.
f5.zh: 我们为澳大利亚家庭匹配经过审核、经验丰富的新西兰月嫂，提供住家或非住家的产后护理、新生儿照护及传统坐月子调理服务。

f7.en: A structured training pathway for anyone in NZ wanting to become a professional postpartum carer, covering newborn care, nutrition, and cross-cultural client care.
f7.zh: 面向新西兰有意成为专业月嫂的人士，系统学习新生儿照护、产后营养及跨文化客户服务等内容。

f9.en: From first enquiry to placement and beyond, our team stays in touch with both families and carers to make sure every arrangement goes smoothly.
f9.zh: 从初次咨询到正式匹配，我们的团队会持续跟进家庭与月嫂双方，确保整个服务过程顺利安心。

f12.en: Tell us about your family's needs and timeline.
f12.zh: 告诉我们您家庭的需求与预计时间

f14.en: We shortlist vetted nannies suited to you.
f14.zh: 我们为您筛选合适的专业月嫂

f16.en: Meet your nanny and confirm the arrangement.
f16.zh: 与月嫂沟通并确认合作细节

f18.en: Care begins, with our team on call throughout.
f18.zh: 服务正式开始，我们全程提供支持
